title: GOD IS YOUR STRENGTH
IN THIS MIDDAY HOUR
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: midday sun rays through wooden blinds
calm wheat field under high noon sun
dust motes dancing in bright window light
clear blue sky over a still meadow
open leather journal on a desk

scenes.a: That decision sitting heavy on your desk requires more than your own tired resolve today.
scenes.sub: YOUR OWN RESOLVE IS NOT ENOUGH

scenes.a: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.
Lord, remove the desire to rely upon my limited wisdom when yours is infinite and perfect.
Let this midday reset remind me that I walk not in my ability but in yours.
May the truth of your righteousness be the anchor that holds me through this coming afternoon.
I surrender my agenda to your sovereign plan, finding peace in your presence right now, Amen.
